scope_note: boundary-protocol reachability + bounded intra-handler scan; NOT whole-program taint. Absence of a finding is not proof of safety.

findings.title: contextBridge global "api" forwards caller-controlled channel names to ipcRenderer
findings.detail: A renderer with any code execution can reach EVERY ipcMain handler — including internal ELECTRON_* channels — through this bridge. This is the exact Discord 2020 RCE exposure class.

findings.title: contextBridge global "bugReporterApi" forwards caller-controlled channel names to ipcRenderer
findings.detail: A renderer with any code execution can reach EVERY ipcMain handler — including internal ELECTRON_* channels — through this bridge. This is the exact Discord 2020 RCE exposure class.

findings.title: setCertificateVerifyProc installed — decision logic needs manual review
findings.detail: A custom certificate verifier exists. Whether it enforces pinning (correct) or rubber-stamps (bypass) is unresolved at this analysis depth.

findings.title: ipcMain handler "bugReporterApiWriteFileChunk" reaches file_write sink(s) with no observed sender validation
findings.detail: Channel has a matching renderer call site. Absence of senderFrame/sender.getURL checks means any compromised renderer can drive it.

findings.title: 2 channel(s) sent but no handler found
findings.detail: Either the handler lives in an unscanned file/native module, or the channel is registered dynamically.

findings.title: 15 handler(s) with no observed renderer send
findings.detail: Internal channels or dynamically-composed names — potentially reachable only via wildcard bridges (see wildcard-ipc-exposure).

findings.title: entire service registry exposed as IPC handlers with the event argument discarded
findings.detail: build/IpcMainService-BZl39Vta.js registers every entry of a services map via ipcMain.handle — sender validation is structurally absent (parameter ignored). 0 computed-name handler(s) found in-file; combined with any renderer compromise + an ungated invoke bridge, every service method is callable.

findings.title: ungated invoke bridge + bulk-registered service registry = 830 privileged methods callable from any compromised renderer
findings.detail: An unguarded contextBridge passthrough (wildcard-ipc-exposure) meets a DI registry where every entry is ipcMain.handle()'d with the event argument discarded. A single XSS, hostile webview, or navigation escape in the window holding the bridge yields the entire privileged surface — file writes, installs, credential and license operations — with no per-channel checks possible.
